violations.text: Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Establishment is to add an indicating symbol to the menu for items that are offered raw or undercooked. Establishment reprinted menus during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back hallway by the walk-in freezer and stairs to the basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on all prep units. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and air circulating fan by the dishwasher have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The floor in the back service area and walk-in cooler is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Floors must be resurfaced so that surface is smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is to use sanitizing bay of 3-bay sink to sanitize dishes after running them through the dishwasher. Call to service was placed during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair prep units #1, #3, and #5. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2025

The floor in the back service area and walk-in cooler is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Floors must be resurfaced so that surface is smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 03/17/2026
